posts.text: The president posted this at 6:18 am on Memorial Day then thought it was so good he re-posted it later in the day.

Army Pvt. 2 Jerod R. Dennis, 19, of Antlers, Oklahoma, 
KIA April 25, 2003 in Afghanistan. #MemorialDayWeekend
Airman 1st Class Raymond Losano, 24, of Del Rio, Texas, KIA April April 25, 2003, in Afghanistan. #MemorialDayWeekend

Marine First Lieutenant Robert M. Kelly, 29, KIA November 9, 2010, Helmand Province, Afghanistan
#MemorialDayWeekend

Army Staff Sgt. Ryan C. Knauss, 23, of Corryton, Tennessee, killed August 26, 2021, as the result of an enemy attack while supporting non-combatant evacuation operations at Abbey Gate, in Kabul, Afghanistan. #MemorialDayWeekend
